environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule 'query-param-pattern-gate' that uses a RegexPatternSet matching the pattern `(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|;|--|/\*)` applied to 'SingleQueryArgument' named 'q' with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode at priority 2. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarming on 4xx/5xx spike, and the ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via security group (no outbound internet for data exfiltration).

config.load_balancer: AWS ALBv2 with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.network_egress: ECS task SG allows outbound only to ALB SG on port 443, no internet egress
config.monitoring: ALB access logs to CloudWatch, metric filter on HTTP 4xx/5xx
config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with minimal permissions
